hint.node: Install Node.js from nodejs.org, then reload the environment in Settings.

hint.goose: Install goose, or choose its binary in Settings › Agents.
hint.kilo: Install Kilo Code, or choose its binary in Settings › Agents.
hint.omp: Install OMP with `bun install -g @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent` or its installer at omp.sh.

hint.muse: Install Muse Code from dev.meta.ai, or choose its binary in Settings › Agents.

hint.harn: Install Harn, or choose its binary in Settings › Agents.
hint.kimchi: Install Kimchi, or choose its binary in Settings › Agents.
